_comment: What this version of the game has instead. Every entry is inert on a runtime
that still has the original: Octo only consults this table after the class or
member has been looked up and genuinely not found, which is what lets one file
be correct on every Minecraft version at once.
'alternatives' are tried in order against the running game. 'stub' says what
may be fabricated when none of them exists either - 'interface' for a type a
mod only implements, 'class' for one it extends or constructs, and nothing at
all when the entry does not say. A stand-in is shaped from the mod's own
bytecode, so the methods it calls are there and return a default.
Drop your own copy of this file in <gameDir>/.octo/api/ to add entries; yours
wins over these one entry at a time.

classes.name: net/minecraft/client/gui/LayeredDraw$Layer
classes.note: the HUD is drawn in named layers from 1.20.5; before that there is no such type, so a mod's layer links and is simply never asked to draw

classes.name: net/minecraft/client/gui/LayeredDraw
classes.note: the container the layers above are registered on

classes.name: net/minecraft/client/renderer/entity/ItemRenderer
classes.note: item rendering left the entity renderer package; the Yarn spelling is listed too, for a mod built against Fabric's names

classes.name: net/minecraft/world/entity/vehicle/MinecartFurnace
classes.note: the powered minecart; Mojang and Yarn disagree on the noun order, and it has moved between the two

classes.name: net/minecraft/client/renderer/entity/ItemEntityRenderer
classes.note: listed because a mod that renders items in the world reaches for both this and ItemRenderer

classes.name: net/neoforged/neoforge/items/ItemStackHandler
classes.note: NeoForge's inventory helper lives in the NeoForge mod, not the loader; the Forge spelling is the same class under its old name

classes.name: net/neoforged/neoforge/items/IItemHandler
classes.note: what the handler above implements, and what mods pass around

classes.name: net/neoforged/neoforge/fluids/FluidInteractionRegistry
classes.note: registering an interaction with nothing listening is harmless; failing to link stops the mod

classes.name: net/neoforged/neoforge/fluids/FluidStack
classes.note: the value type the registry above deals in

classes.name: com/tterrag/registrate/AbstractRegistrate
classes.note: Registrate is a library Create ships inside its own jar. Octo now keeps a jar-in-jar payload that is not a mod on the class path, so the real one is normally found; this entry is the answer for a build that does not bundle it

classes.name: com/tterrag/registrate/util/entry/RegistryEntry
classes.note: what every Registrate builder hands back

methods.name: shouldTriggerItemUseEffects
methods.note: the eating/drinking particle tick; renamed more than once, and mixed into by every animation mod

methods.name: reloadResourcePacks
methods.note: a mixin naming a lambda inside this method is matched by name rather than by the compiler's index; see MixinTargets

fields.name: entries
fields.note: the crash report's detail map; mixins reach it through an accessor, and a field of that exact type is unique on the class, so it is found even under a name nobody listed here
